test_set.query: 사용자 이름과 그들이 주문한 횟수를 조회해줘
test_set.answer: SELECT u.name, COUNT(o.id) as order_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id GROUP BY u.id, u.name;

test_set.query: 각 도서가 몇 번 주문되었는지 조회해줘
test_set.answer: SELECT b.title, COUNT(oi.id) as order_count FROM books b LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON b.id = oi.book_id GROUP BY b.id, b.title;
SELECT b.title, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_sold FROM books b JOIN order_items oi ON b.id = oi.book_id GROUP BY b.id, b.title ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT b.* FROM books b LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON b.id = oi.book_id WHERE oi.id IS NULL;
SELECT u.name, SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) as total_amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY u.id, u.name;

SELECT u.name, SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) as total_amount FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY u.id, u.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT DISTINCT b.* FROM books b JOIN order_items oi ON b.id = oi.book_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.user_id = 1;
SELECT DISTINCT b.* FROM books b JOIN order_items oi ON b.id = oi.book_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE DATE(o.order_date) = CURDATE();

SELECT b.title, SUM(oi.quantity) as total_sold FROM books b JOIN order_items oi ON b.id = oi.book_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE YEAR(o.order_date) = 2026 AND MONTH(o.order_date) = 2 GROUP BY b.id, b.title ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM orders GROUP BY status;
SELECT SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) as total_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'SHIPPED';
SELECT AVG(order_total) as avg_order_amount FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(price * quantity) as order_total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) as order_totals;
SELECT COUNT(*) as new_users FROM users WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY);
SELECT COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY);
SELECT SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) as monthly_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE YEAR(o.order_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(o.order_date) = MONTH(CURDATE());
